row: Physiotrendz is Voice of all Physios, Who believe that with Proper knowledge and Awareness we can get the desired Respect and Position among Healthcare Professionals. Physiotrendz is where you learn and see information regarding Physical therapy education related skills as well as Information regarding future scope and current Scenario about the field around the world. I Physio Prem Shah have more then 7 years of experience in field of physiotherapy working as Associate Professor with expectation of shaping future physios such a way that all be confident enough to speak for the field of Physiotherapy. I hope you find your meets related to physiotherapy here, and if don't please let me know by comments on any video. I would love to answer any query.
